role: independent source reviewer, distinct from header author

objects.original: Literal Phi,S,lambda,Lambda, prescribed poststates and path, completed prefix factors and terminal survival.
objects.reconstructed: 20 unchanged let blocks, followed by augmented real grid and explicitly clamped gamma.
objects.evidence: All20 exact UTF8 block comparisons pass; clamping is explicit new representation.

domains.original: Euclidean phase, fixed y/reference/initial phase, strict finite simplex and physical interval[0,T].
domains.reconstructed: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E; n:Nat,T:NNReal,t:Prefix n T; phase E x E; gamma:Real->phase.
domains.evidence: Finite Hilbert/rank0 elaboration disclosed; NNReal ensures finite T>=0; Prefix encodes0<t1<...<tn<T. No law on reference/initial phase.

quantifiers.original: Each fixed deterministic parameter choice, every finite prescribed tuple and each jump before finite T.
quantifiers.reconstructed: forall y xRef z0 n T t, with forall i:Fin n for phase and rate left limits.
quantifiers.evidence: Header quantifier line73; no AE weakening, no requirement of realizable clock tuple.

assumptions.original: alpha>0,alpha<=beta,V C2,global two-sided Hessian quadratic bounds,eta>0,beta eta<=1.
assumptions.evidence: No integrability, continuity, positive rate, finite-wait, stochastic-law or path-topology binder added. alpha,beta:NNReal encode already nonnegative source constants.

conclusion.original: Deterministic bridge needed for printed A7: finite integrability, hazard sum including last arc, incoming left limits and survival-times-prejump density.
conclusion.reconstructed: IntervalIntegrable rate(gamma)0T; equality to sum j:Fin(n+1) of Lambda at next-minus-current grid; phase and rate Tendsto at each incoming jump; rho equals ofReal(exp(-whole hazard)*product incoming rates).
conclusion.evidence: Four conjunction blocks; rate limit follows source continuity but remains a conclusion, not hypothesis. Product uses incoming explicit states whose limits are separately asserted.

scopes.original: Finite prescribed deterministic identity contributing to A7; source does not specify a path topology.
scopes.reconstructed: Real time one-sided filter to ordinary finite-dimensional phase/rate topologies; no topology on Path or Skorokhod assertion.
scopes.evidence: Clamping equals original prescribed path on[0,T] and locally at each0<t_i<T. No whole-A7 expectation or countable-sum conclusion.

constant_dependencies.original: Fixed V,eta,y,reference,z0,n,T,t; source alpha,beta constrain V and eta.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Same data; no cap or unexplained choice of bound enters any conclusion.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Finite hazard sum depends on actual poststates and n+1 gaps; no additional analytic constant.

index_audit.sum: j:Fin(n+1); grid j.castSucc=t_j, grid j.succ=t_(j+1), state zAt j=z_j. Final j=n uses T-tn.
index_audit.incoming: i:Fin n has zero-based index k. t.val i=t_(k+1); grid i.castSucc.castSucc=t_k; zAt i.castSucc=z_k. Thus target is incoming Phi_(t_(k+1)-t_k)(z_k), not post-bounce z_(k+1).
index_audit.clipping: Real.toNNReal of each gap and NNReal terminal subtraction agree with genuine differences by strict ordering; no new clipped mathematics on valid tuples.

extension_audit.agreement: For0<=s<=T, the argument is s; s<0 clamps to0 and s>T clamps toT.
extension_audit.left_limit: For each jump,0<t_i<T supplies an open real neighborhood contained in(0,T), where clamp is identity. Therefore ordinary real nhdsWithin(Iio t_i) sees exactly the incoming arc.
extension_audit.not_global_continuity: No continuity of gamma across bounce or of S in state is claimed.
extension_audit.rate_limit: Continuous source rate composed with the phase limit gives same pre-jump rate; phase discontinuity at jump does not change one-sided statement.

edge_cases.n0_Tpositive: Empty jump product=1; one arc; rho0=exp(-Lambda_z0(T)), generally less than1.
edge_cases.n0_T0: Singleton empty tuple, constant initial phase at the sole coordinate, zero integral and density1.
edge_cases.npositive_T0: Strict simplex empty; all tuple statements vacuous, corresponding measure term zero.
edge_cases.rank0: Unique phase, rate and hazard zero; density0 on any n>0 tuple because all jump-rate factors vanish. No assumption of positive density.
edge_cases.zero_rate_or_infinite_actual_wait: Prescribed finite path is still defined even if impossible under actual clocks; zero rate factors give zero density. No finite waiting-time premise is needed.

source_vs_ASTIS: Source prints prescribed arcs and A7 expression; finite null-set/integrability/translation/stitching, explicit incoming Tendsto and clamped extension are ASTIS completions. No attribution of these elaborated clauses as an independently printed theorem.
future_proof_obligations: Prove clamp/interval agreement and local left-neighborhood agreement.
Prove finite-arc rate continuity/integrability and finite endpoint-null replacement without identifying distinct jump values.
Prove n+1-arc integral splitting and time translation including terminal arc and n0,T0.
Prove incoming phase and rate limits from strict simplex order.
Prove exact q/rho exponential and nonnegative ofReal product algebra.
consumer: TERM93 substitutes this density equality into existing finite-count complete-history/path law93; later A7 still needs countable assembly and bounded signed-test convergence.
